# temps_user (Resource)

A Temps console user. `initial_roles` and `password` only seed the account; assign further roles with `temps_user_role` and let the user change their own password. Destroying the resource deletes the user, which an administrator can restore from the console.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `users:read`, `users:create`, `users:write`, `users:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_user" "ops" {
  username      = "ops"
  email         = "ops@example.com"
  password      = var.ops_initial_password
  initial_roles = ["user"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `initial_roles` (Set of String) Roles the user starts with, for example `user` or `admin`. Only used when the resource is created; changing it later has no effect.
- `username` (String) User name, also shown as the display name. Changing it renames the user in place.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `must_change_password` (Boolean) Ask the user to choose a new password at first sign-in. Only used when the resource is created; changing it later has no effect.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Starting password. Omit it to have Temps generate one. Only used when the resource is created; changing it later has no effect.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user has turned on multi-factor authentication.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles the user holds now.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>
terraform import temps_user.ops 12
```
